claim: REQ-511's own EARS clause is internally self-contradictory about the total bound on think() calls per wake, and this contradiction is echoed inconsistently across the spec pair, making the pure `nextRerouteState` state machine's exact ceiling value ambiguous and therefore not unambiguously implementable/testable from the spec as written. REQ-511's EARS text (behavioral-spec.md:378-382) reads: "THE SYSTEM SHALL bound the total extra model calls added by always-act enforcement to at most 2 per wake BEYOND the baseline single think() call (REQ-505's 1 reprompt + REQ-506's 1 reroute ... so the practical worst case is 1 extra call, not 2, but the hard ceiling asserted by tests is 2)" -- read literally, 'at most 2 ... BEYOND the baseline' means total <= 3 (1 baseline + 2 extra), yet the same sentence's parenthetical says 'the hard ceiling asserted by tests is 2', which can only be consistent with the REST of the spec if it means 2 TOTAL, not 2 extra. This second (2-total) reading is what PROP-511a (verification-architecture.md:106) actually asserts verbatim: "total think() calls per wake ... never exceed 2", and it is also what REQ-505's own acceptance criteria (behavioral-spec.md:258-259, 'asserts exactly 2 think() invocations total (not more)') and REQ-506's own acceptance criteria (behavioral-spec.md:298-299, '...a second think() call occurs...') both independently confirm (baseline + 1 = 2 total, never 3). verification-architecture.md's own Pure Core description of `nextRerouteState` (line 40) also says 'the single shared counter enforcing REQ-511's <=2 ceiling' -- i.e. every OTHER place in the spec pair agrees on a 2-TOTAL ceiling (1 shared extra-call budget), and only REQ-511's own EARS-clause prose literally states 'at most 2 ... BEYOND the baseline', which is off by one and would lead an implementer who takes REQ-511's plain first sentence at face value to build `maxAttempts=2` (permitting 3 total calls) instead of the `maxAttempts=1` value every other requirement/PROP in the spec actually depends on.
evidence: behavioral-spec.md:378-382 (REQ-511 EARS text: 'at most 2 per wake beyond the baseline single think() call ... the hard ceiling asserted by tests is 2') contradicts behavioral-spec.md:258-259 (REQ-505 AC: 'exactly 2 think() invocations total'), behavioral-spec.md:298-299 (REQ-506 AC: 'a second think() call occurs' = 2nd of 2 total), verification-architecture.md:40 ('the single shared counter enforcing REQ-511's <=2 ceiling'), and verification-architecture.md:106 (PROP-511a: 'total think() calls per wake ... never exceed 2').
required_fix: Rewrite REQ-511's EARS clause to state the ceiling as a single, unambiguous number consistent with the rest of the spec: 'bound the total extra model calls added by always-act enforcement to at most 1 per wake beyond the baseline single think() call (a single shared budget covering EITHER REQ-505's reprompt OR REQ-506's reroute, never both in the same wake), so total think() calls per wake never exceed 2.' Remove the '2 ... beyond the baseline' framing entirely so `nextRerouteState`'s `maxAttempts` parameter has one unambiguous specified value (1) that matches PROP-511a and every acceptance criterion elsewhere in the spec.
